answers.core: Unsure if this would be possible as an add-on at all.
answers.workaround:
From what I can tell, the two workarounds are flawed:
- `create_from_images` works, but if the resource is saved as part of another resource or scene, it embeds the images as byte arrays instead of re-using the existing image resources (.png files imported as `Image`).
- Editing the resource or scene file manually to use `ExtResource` is likely not something the Godot developers intend people to do, and doing so appears to be a temporary solution, as the Texture2DArray resource will just switch to embedding the images instead at some point.

title: Create Texture2DArray resource in editor with separate images
